Subject: POC kickoff — FiberPay hands-on lab & load window coordination

Hi Samira / Eli,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. We’re ready to schedule the hands-on POC kickoff and a short load run so your engineering team can validate routing, prompt templates, and throughput against expected traffic patterns. Proposed structure:

- 90-min kickoff (stakeholder intros, roles & success criteria, prompt review, routing rules)
- 30–45 min hands-on prompt calibration in the studio
- Follow-up 30-min load window (separate run day or same afternoon depending on availability)

Can you confirm who will join from FiberPay (eng / security / product)? Also helpful: a short list of 8–10 representative prompts (we included sample-prompts.csv) and any constraints (IP allowlist, auth scheme).

I’ve attached a tentative agenda (poc-agenda.pdf). For dates, we have the following windows open (PT):
- Thu 2026-11-12, 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Mon 2026-11-15, 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-11-18, 10:00–11:30 (preferred from our side)

If you prefer a separate load day, tell us which day looks best and we’ll reserve capacity. Next steps once date is locked: 1) share final attendee list and test prompts, 2) we’ll provision a staging model variant and a temporary dashboard to monitor latency/cost, and 3) agree on load parameters (TPS, concurrency, duration).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—Karthik

I’ll attach our internal test plan after I loop Priya. For now I’ll confirm 11/18 for the kickoff.

Thanks for confirming 11/18, Samira — we’ll lock that. A few clarifications from our side to make the session productive:

- Success criteria (please confirm): 1) routing honors JWT tenant header and lands in the right model variant, 2) prompt templates produce >= 0.85 relevance on your eval set, 3) service sustains target throughput with p95 latency < 350ms.
- Load parameters: we can run a 30-minute load window targeting 150 requests/sec peak, ~1.2M tokens total. If you need a different burst pattern (spikes vs steady), tell us.
- Security checklist: we can support JWT header routing and will provide a short IP allowlist range for the staging endpoints. Please send Priya’s email so we can share the allowlist and a test API key (scoped and time-limited).

I’ve also posted a short runbook with proposed steering values and the temporary dashboard link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefG-poc-materials

Agenda for 11/18 (draft):
- 10:00: quick intros & roles (15m)
- 10:15: success criteria and prompt review (20m)
- 10:35: hands-on prompt calibration in studio (25m)
- 11:00: next steps & load plan confirmation (15m)

We’ll attach the runbook to the calendar invite. If you want to move the load to the same afternoon, we’re flexible to reserve the afternoon window.

—Marissa
